provenance: Generated symbols only. ISO/IEC 18004 is paywalled, so no sample symbol from the standard is reproduced here. Every expected value below is a structural or arithmetic property of the format itself — symbol size from clause 6.3.1, the 4-module quiet zone, the three finder patterns, the alternating timing pattern, the single always-dark module, the 15-bit BCH(15,5) format word, the mask penalty rules of clause 8.8.2, and Reed-Solomon syndromes being zero over GF(256) with primitive polynomial 0x11D.
oracle: Byte equality is authoritative for the payload. The decoder under test is a separate path from the encoder: it locates finder patterns in rendered pixels, solves a perspective transform, samples the grid, reads the symbol's own format field, and verifies the syndromes before returning a byte. Agreement between the two is therefore independent of any shared helper.
rights: No ISO sample symbol bytes are copied.
